commands.command:
set -e
sudo mkdir -p /srv
sudo fallocate -l 4G /srv/lvm-backing.img
sudo losetup -f /srv/lvm-backing.img
losetup -a

set -e
sudo pvcreate /dev/loop0
sudo vgcreate vg_data /dev/loop0
sudo lvcreate -L 2G -n lv_data vg_data
sudo mkfs.ext4 -q /dev/vg_data/lv_data
sudo mkdir -p /srv/data
echo "/dev/vg_data/lv_data /srv/data ext4 defaults 0 2" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab
sudo mount /srv/data
df -hT /srv/data
sudo vgs; sudo lvs

commands.command:
set -e
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/attach-vgdata-loop.service
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device backing vg_data before local filesystems mount
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs-pre.target
After=systemd-udevd.service
Requires=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 /srv/lvm-backing.img
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable attach-vgdata-loop.service
sudo sed -i 's#^/dev/vg_data/lv_data.*#/dev/vg_data/lv_data /srv/data ext4 defaults,x-systemd.requires=attach-vgdata-loop.service 0 2#' /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | tail -3
